verdict.rationale: Drata publishes the source of one component, its endpoint agent, in a public GitHub repo (drata/drata-agent) with local build instructions, so some product source is readable. The core compliance SaaS platform shows no public source, and the evidence never names the agent repo's license, so the 'open license' part is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: an explicitly stated open-source license, public source for the core Drata platform (API, workflows, trust center), and independent confirmation of the repo's licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
